title: API Keys
subtitle: Allow external systems to authenticate with Inventari
noKeysDescription: Generate an API key to allow scripts, Home Assistant, or other automations to connect.

table.name: Name
table.revokedTrace: A revoked key leaves this list. The revocation is recorded in the audit log.

revokeConfirm.title: Revoke API Key
revokeConfirm.message: Are you sure you want to revoke the key "{{name}}"? It will stop working immediately.

form.title: Generate New API Key

expirationOptions.never: No expiry — works until it is revoked

scopeExplain.printing: A printing key works only for the Inventari Print Agent: it can register the agent, take print jobs, fetch their labels and report how they went. It cannot read or change anything else.
scopeExplain.other: A {{scope}} key reaches only the endpoints that guard these permissions, and cannot read or change anything else:

form.scopesLoadFailed: What a key may carry could not be loaded, so no key can be issued right now.
form.permissionsHint: Only what you hold yourself can be given to a key.
form.readOnlyHint: A new key starts read-only. Tick a write permission only if the key must change data — it can then change whatever that permission covers, such as adding products or changing stock levels.

copyDialog.title: API Key Generated
copyDialog.warning: Make sure to copy your API key now. You won't be able to see it again!

capabilities.title: What a key can carry
capabilities.intro: Each key carries the permissions ticked when it is issued — at most what the person issuing it holds. Its list stands beside it below. A printing key reaches only the print agent's endpoints.
capabilities.adminBlocked: Anything administrative — roles, invitations, modules, other API keys — stays closed to a key. The team list does not: a key holding "Read the organization's details" can read every member's name, e-mail and role.

permissions.items_write: Add products and change stock levels
permissions.org_settings_write: Administer the organization: AI connections, equipment document templates, the organization-wide SKU naming and the API key register

capabilities.loadFailed: What a key can do could not be loaded.

usage.title: How to send it
usage.hint: The key travels in the {{header}} header. Sent as Authorization: Bearer it still works until the next minor release, and every answer then carries a Deprecation header.

revokedToast: Key revoked — recorded in the audit log
